stemEn: Which symptom is commonly associated with an orbital floor fracture?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار diplopia ويذكر أنها شائعة في blowout/orbital fractures بسبب تأثر حركة العين أو انحشار العضلات.
clinicalPearl: Diplopia is a classic orbital fracture clue.

tts.text: Which symptom is commonly associated with an orbital floor fracture? Option A, diplopia. Option B, hyphema. Option C, exophthalmos.

stemEn: A patient has acute eye pain, photophobia and redness; fluorescein examination is shown in the original image. What is the diagnosis?
explanationAr: المصدر يسمّي الصورة Corneal abrasion. لأن التشخيص في السؤال يعتمد على fluorescein image، يجب ربط الصورة الأصلية قبل النشر.

tts.text: A patient has acute eye pain, photophobia and redness; fluorescein examination is shown in the original image. What is the diagnosis? Option A, corneal abrasion.

stemEn: A stable 13-year-old has left upper-quadrant and referred left-shoulder pain after blunt abdominal trauma. What is the next investigation?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار CT abdomen في الطفل hemodynamically stable مع suspicion قوي لإصابة الطحال، ويذكر أن CT أكثر حساسية لتحديد موقع ودرجة solid-organ injury.
clinicalPearl: Stable suspected solid-organ injury is evaluated with CT in the source framing.

tts.text: A stable thirteen-year-old has left upper-quadrant and referred left-shoulder pain after blunt abdominal trauma. What is the next investigation? Option A, abdominal ultrasound. Option B, CT abdomen. Option C, abdominal plain radiograph.

stemEn: After blunt abdominal trauma, ultrasound shows a splenic tear and the child is tachycardic and hypotensive. What next step did the source key select?
explanationAr: المصدر يسجل B: CT abdomen، لكنه في الشرح نفسه يقول إن hemodynamically unstable child بسبب intra-abdominal bleeding غير المستجيب للسوائل والدم يحتاج emergency laparotomy. لأن الـstem لا يذكر الاستجابة للresuscitation، تم حفظ السؤال كـconflicting بدل اعتماد CT كقاعدة.
clinicalPearl: Hemodynamic response to resuscitation is the missing switch that changes management.

tts.text: After blunt abdominal trauma, ultrasound shows a splenic tear and the child is tachycardic and hypotensive. What next step did the source key select? Option B, CT abdomen. Option C, surgery.

stemEn: A child develops delayed bilious vomiting several days after a bicycle-handlebar abdominal injury. What is the diagnosis?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار duodenal hematoma؛ blunt handlebar injury قد يسبب intramural duodenal hematoma وتظهر obstructive symptoms بعد تأخير، بخلاف perforation التي تميل لظهور acute pain/tenderness مبكرًا.
clinicalPearl: Delayed obstruction after handlebar trauma points to duodenal hematoma in the source.

tts.text: A child develops delayed bilious vomiting several days after a bicycle-handlebar abdominal injury. What is the diagnosis? Option A, duodenal hematoma. Option B, gastric hematoma. Option C, duodenal perforation. Option D, splenic rupture.

stemEn: After an RTA, the original chest/abdominal radiograph shows pneumoperitoneum. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار intestinal perforation؛ free intraperitoneal air on plain film is the key clue. الصورة الأصلية مطلوبة قبل النشر.
clinicalPearl: Post-traumatic free intraperitoneal air suggests hollow-viscus perforation.

tts.text: After a road traffic accident, the original chest and abdominal radiograph shows pneumoperitoneum. What is the most likely diagnosis? Option A, pneumothorax. Option B, diaphragmatic rupture. Option C, intestinal perforation. Option D, splenic rupture.

stemEn: A 6-year-old develops respiratory distress after blunt sports trauma; the original radiograph shows air anterior to the heart. What is the diagnosis?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار pneumomediastinum ويشرح أنه قد ينتج من alveolar rupture بعد trauma، وقد يصاحبه subcutaneous emphysema أو Hamman sign. الصورة الأصلية لازمة.
clinicalPearl: Traumatic mediastinal air is the source diagnosis.

tts.text: A six-year-old develops respiratory distress after blunt sports trauma; the original radiograph shows air anterior to the heart. What is the diagnosis? Option A, pneumomediastinum. Option B, hiatal hernia. Option C, anterior congenital diaphragmatic hernia. Option D, pneumothorax.

stemEn: A trauma patient has blood at the urethral meatus and a pelvic fracture. What should be done before urethral catheterization?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار retrograde urethrogram قبل catheterization عند الاشتباه في urethral injury بسبب blood at meatus/pelvic fracture.
clinicalPearl: Do not blindly catheterize when urethral injury is suspected.

tts.text: A trauma patient has blood at the urethral meatus and a pelvic fracture. What should be done before urethral catheterization? Option A, ultrasound. Option B, CT abdomen with contrast. Option C, retrograde urethrogram. Option D, insert a catheter.

stemEn: A child with three rib fractures after blunt chest trauma is stable on room air but has significant pain. What is the most appropriate next step?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار analgesia؛ الطفل hemodynamically stable ولا يعاني respiratory distress، لذلك الألم يحتاج علاجًا بينما intubation غير مبررة من المعطيات.
clinicalPearl: Adequate analgesia supports ventilation in stable rib-fracture patients.

tts.text: A child with three rib fractures after blunt chest trauma is stable on room air but has significant pain. What is the most appropriate next step? Option A, administer pain medication. Option B, endotracheal intubation.
